import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import serializers

orders = [
    {"id": 17, "customer": {"name": "  ada lovelace "}, "lines": [{"qty": 2, "unit_price": 12.5}, {"qty": 1, "unit_price": 3.0}]},
    {"id": 18, "customer": {"name": "BOB"}, "lines": []},
]
for order in orders:
    print(serializers.order_created_event(order))
    print(serializers.order_row(order))
for bad in ({"id": 1, "customer": {}, "lines": []}, {"customer": {"name": "x"}, "lines": []}, {"id": 2, "customer": {"name": "x"}}):
    for func in (serializers.order_created_event, serializers.order_row):
        try:
            func(bad)
        except KeyError as exc:
            print(func.__name__, "KeyError", exc)
print("ok")
